faqs.q: What file formats do you accept for commercial printing projects?
faqs.a: We accept high-resolution PDF files as well as native files from common design programs such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. Our team reviews all files and provides guidance on preparation to ensure optimal print quality.

faqs.q: Do you offer both digital and offset printing?
faqs.a: Yes. Digital printing is ideal for shorter runs and variable data, while offset printing provides excellent color reproduction for larger volumes. We recommend the best method based on your quantity, timeline, and budget requirements.

In-house designers are available to refine layouts, optimize images, select appropriate paper stocks, and prepare files. Whether you need minor adjustments or full creative support, one team handles every detail.

faqs.q: Can printed materials be sent directly into a mailing program?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Completed pieces move seamlessly into fulfillment or into the Postalocity platform for automated mailing, address verification, and prompt submission to USPS — all managed by the same concierge team.

faqs.q: What types of finishing options are available?
faqs.a: We provide folding, scoring, die-cutting, binding, perforating, and other in-house finishing services. This ensures professional presentation whether producing brochures, business cards, forms, or marketing collateral.

faqs.q: How does the concierge model benefit commercial printing projects?
faqs.a: One dedicated point of contact oversees the entire workflow — from file review through production, finishing, and optional mailing. This eliminates coordination across multiple vendors and helps organizations reclaim operational time weekly.

faqs.q: Do you support variable data printing?
faqs.a: Yes. Our digital capabilities support personalized printing for targeted marketing materials, statements, invoices, and other variable-data projects with consistent quality and efficiency.

faqs.q: What is the process for obtaining a free estimate?
faqs.a: Simply call 316-262-3333, email orders@broadstrokeinc.com, or submit details through our contact form. A member of our team will review your project and provide a clear, no-obligation estimate with recommended options and timelines.
